card.name: Of after a percentage or statistic
card.fires_on: The word 'of' (or the percent sign or number piece) right after a percentage or count in statistics about populations, such as '22% of the total'. Also digits and '$' inside figures just before a number is completed.

modes.label: Of after percent

modes.description: The word 'percent' after a decimal number in a share statistic.
modes.example: making up 40.2<< percent>> of all inmates in the system.
